title: doscomandos: ls | tr
summary: Two children and a pipe: the shell's | done by hand.
hints: Pipe first, then two children. Child 1: `dup2(p[1], STDOUT_FILENO)`, close both ends, `execlp("ls", ...)`. Child 2: `dup2(p[0], STDIN_FILENO)`, close both ends, `execlp("tr", ...)`.
The parent closes both ends and waits twice. If any copy of the write end stays open, `tr` never sees the end of its input and hangs.
